newsitem.title: YEMEN: Team from Kuwait's KIA in Yemen for economic talks.
newsitem.headline: Team from Kuwait's KIA in Yemen for economic talks.

text.p: A delegation from the Kuwait Investment Authority (KIA) is in Yemen for talks on economic cooperation, the official al-Thawra newspaper said on Monday.
"The delegation will meet officials at the ministry of finance and the central bank and discuss economic, banking and financial cooperation," the paper said.
KIA manages Kuwait's foreign investments of more than $40 billion.
Kuwaiti officials have been quoted by the media as saying Yemen owes KIA some $320 million in loans and interest.
The paper said the delegation arrived in Sanaa late on Sunday for a visit of several days.
Ties between Yemen and Kuwait have been strained since the Gulf War over what Kuwait saw as Sanaa's sympathy for Iraq.
